title: Recording: Mind Games by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The seventh and penultimate day of overdubs for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 17 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. The overdubs recorded on this day are not known, but the session ran from 7pm until 6.30am the following day.
